license_summary: Original project asset inventory only. Third-party CC0 environment and trackside foundations are recorded separately in assets/licenses/third-party-assets.json. No external trademarks, sponsor marks, fonts, vehicle geometry, textures, or liveries were incorporated in the project-original Formula car. Generated concept rasters were created specifically for this project, visually reviewed before integration, and preserve no protected branding from visual references.
